name: Pets.com
title: Was Pets.com too early? No: it sold below cost
question: Was Pets.com too early for online pet supplies?
answer: Pets.com went public in February 2000 and liquidated in November 2000. It sold heavy, low-margin goods below cost and paid to ship them. Chewy (2011) sold the same products online without any technology that was missing in 2000, and PetSmart bought it for $3.35B in 2017. No enabler crossed in between; the economics were the problem.
verdict_reason: Chewy needed no technology that Pets.com lacked.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.
